context: Thread: a suit for recovery of money lent. The limitation position is NOT established: the date of the last acknowledgement is unresolved, so whether Article 19 or Article 113 governs, and whether the period has run, are both open. The client has produced a ledger and an email. No proceeding is filed.

cases.step: Ask the client for the bank statements covering March to June 2023.
cases.label: independent
cases.why: gathering material; no position on time is taken

cases.step: Write to the client confirming which of the two ledgers is the one they rely on.
cases.label: independent

cases.step: Preserve the original email and record its header data before the account is closed.
cases.label: independent

cases.step: Read the ledger and set out what it does and does not establish about repayment.
cases.label: independent
cases.why: examining supplied evidence without asserting a consequence

cases.step: Take the client's instructions on whether they wish to proceed at all.
cases.label: independent
cases.why: instructions, not a commitment to a course

cases.step: Obtain a certified copy of the partnership deed from the Registrar.
cases.label: independent

cases.step: File the suit for recovery in the City Civil Court this week.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: commits to relief whose maintainability turns on the unresolved period

cases.step: Advise the client that the claim is within time and may safely be filed next month.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: asserts timeliness, which is the unresolved premise itself

cases.step: Tell the client the claim is time-barred and recommend that they abandon it.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: abandons relief on the strength of the unresolved position

cases.step: Issue a statutory notice demanding payment within fifteen days, then sue on its expiry.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: a compound step whose second half commits to suit

cases.step: Draft the plaint pleading that the cause of action arose on 4 March 2023.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: pleads the accrual date the position has not established

cases.step: Apply for condonation of delay under section 5 of the Limitation Act.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: presupposes that the period has expired

cases.step: Advise the client that no further step is worth taking on this thread.
cases.label: dependent

cases.step: Collect the correspondence and, if it shows an acknowledgement, file immediately.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: compound: the second limb commits to filing

cases.step: Obtain a copy of the charge sheet as a priority, since the case is listed for hearing on 6 October 2026.
cases.label: independent
cases.why: gathering; the listing date is urgency, not a time-bar

cases.step: Collect the lease deed and the rent receipts before the hearing next week.
cases.label: independent
cases.why: gathering; the hearing date is urgency

cases.step: Before the reply date on 12 November, file a written statement pleading that the suit is barred by limitation.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: CONTROL: asserts a time-bar; the date framing changes nothing

cases.step: File the suit before the hearing on the interim application so both are heard together.
cases.label: dependent
cases.why: CONTROL: commits to relief; the date framing changes nothing
